question: Can restricting Q2.6 quantity learning to the top transformer feed-forward sublayer and final normalization preserve the promoted quantity faculty while avoiding ZERO.4's prospective TinyStories language-gate failure?
independent_variable: replace Q2.6 full-model trainability with the exact top-ffn trainable scope; all other scientific settings remain inherited

diagnosis.interpretation: ZERO.4 preserved and improved the bounded BLiMP screen but failed the prospective candidate gate because TinyStories bits/byte regressed by about 1.681%, above the frozen 1% ceiling.

scope_selection_evidence.method: aggregate absolute per-attempt group replay drift, displacement norm, and Fisher-weighted drift from the already-completed Q2.6 diagnostic trace; no new model evaluation
scope_selection_evidence.interpretation: The token embedding is the dominant replay-sensitive group while the top FFN matrices are the two largest displacement carriers. Top-FFN isolation is therefore a prospective hypothesis, not a conclusion from language-gate tuning.

student.reason_not_initialized_from_zero4: ZERO.4 is the observed language-regressed outcome. Q2.7 reruns the same quantity-learning question from the immutable language-preserving ZERO.3 initialization with one isolated intervention.

trainable_scope.frozen_policy: weights and both AdamW moment arrays are byte-identical across every optimizer proposal, projection, retry, commit, rejection, checkpoint, and resume
trainable_scope.gradient_norm_policy: global clipping norm is computed only in the declared trainable subspace
trainable_scope.projection_policy: the unchanged Q2.6 global tangent projection is computed and applied only in the declared trainable subspace

execution_order: run diagnostic seed 2 from immutable ZERO.3 under the exact top-ffn scope
select a public-feasible quantity/replay checkpoint using the unchanged Q2.6 rule with the promotion split still sealed
if and only if a public-feasible checkpoint exists, evaluate the quantity promotion split exactly once
if and only if quantity promotion passes, run the frozen candidate-only BLiMP and TinyStories language gate exactly once
declare diagnostic go only if quantity, replay, promotion, and both language gates pass
authorize seeds 1 and 3 only under a separate frozen replication contract and budget after diagnostic go

forbidden: using BLiMP or TinyStories examples for training
using either external metric for checkpoint selection
changing the trainable scope or thresholds after observing the gate
claiming general LLM capability or equivalence

diagnostic_policy.go: one prospectively selected seed-2 checkpoint passes every inherited Q2.6 quantity and replay gate, the exactly-once quantity promotion gate, and both frozen language-preservation gates
diagnostic_policy.no_go: no jointly feasible checkpoint exists under the frozen stop conditions, quantity promotion fails, or either language-preservation gate fails

required: portable C and Accelerate/OpenBLAS builds pass the C self-test
the self-test proves all frozen weights and AdamW moments remain byte-identical through optimizer update and tangent projection
the self-test proves exactly four declared parameter groups move
uninterrupted and resumed top-ffn smoke checkpoints are byte-identical
a top-ffn checkpoint refuses resume without the matching scope
the literary preset reports exactly 541184 trainable parameters

authorization.next_authority: After mechanics merge, measure or conservatively bound the top-ffn diagnostic on AWS, freeze a separate immutable budget and non-waiting launch/collector workflow, then request explicit authorization.
